An interactive application that allows the user to explore the components of the MHW definition.

This interactive demonstration breaks down the core components of the marine heatwave definition and allows users to explore how events are detected. It is intended as a lightweight teaching and communication tool for explaining the methodology behind marine heatwave identification.

**Links:** [Link](https://robert-schlegel.shinyapps.io/demoMHW)
